rust.name: crates/factorium/src/idle.rs:113:60: replace || with && in App::idle_start
rust.why: The daemon's new one-at-a-time guard is beside_runs || queued, but a hand run shares the queue from another process and every concurrent tick in the tests is on a busy host (or after the run has finished), while idle_runs checks queued() on its own, so && still leaves the suite green.
